app_updates.title: Clash Web application updates
app_updates.description: Check GitHub for stable Clash Web releases and update the web interface and management service.
app_updates.interval_help: Use 0 for manual checks, or a whole number from 1 to 720 hours.
app_updates.auto_help: Checks run in the background even when the browser is closed. With automatic installation enabled, new releases are downloaded, verified and installed, then the web service restarts. Local configuration is preserved and this page reloads when the service returns.

app_updates.not_checked: GitHub has not been checked yet.
